requirements.title: IEEE_RINT ROUND argument selects integral rounding mode
requirements.definition: With ROUND present, IEEE_RINT rounds X to an integer according to the mode specified by ROUND.

pending.IEEE_RINT-ROUND-present-directed-modes: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-1.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING for IEEE_UP, IEEE_DOWN, and IEEE_TO_ZERO; supported branch asserts IEEE_RINT(1.5,IEEE_UP)==2.0, IEEE_RINT(1.5,IEEE_DOWN)==1.0, and IEEE_RINT(-1.5,IEEE_TO_ZERO)==-1.0. Mutations swap ROUND values.
pending.IEEE_RINT-ROUND-present-nearest-ties-to-: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,1.0), and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE observer support; supported branch asserts IEEE_RINT(2.5,IEEE_NEAREST)==2.0, IEEE_RINT(3.5,IEEE_NEAREST)==4.0, and IEEE_RINT(-2.5,IEEE_NEAREST)==-2.0 with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE true for the negative result. These are exact ties to even from roundToIntegral{rounding}. Mutations expect away-from-zero ties.
pending.IEEE_RINT-ROUND-present-nearest-no-inexa: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INEXACT,2.5), and FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_INEXACT,2.5); supported branch clears all supported flags, evaluates IEEE_RINT(2.5,IEEE_NEAREST), and asserts IEEE_INEXACT remains quiet because p6 names roundToIntegral{rounding}, not roundToIntegralExact. Mutation expects IEEE_INEXACT signaling.

requirements.title: IEEE_RINT without ROUND uses the current rounding mode
requirements.definition: Without ROUND, IEEE_RINT returns roundToIntegralExact using the current rounding mode.

pending.IEEE_RINT-ROUND-absent-current-mode: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING for IEEE_UP and IEEE_DOWN, and IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support; supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_DOWN and GET confirms IEEE_DOWN before asserting IEEE_RINT(1.5)==1.0, then sets IEEE_UP and GET confirms IEEE_UP before asserting IEEE_RINT(1.5)==2.0, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. Mutation leaves the mode unchanged.
pending.IEEE_RINT-current-nearest-ties-to-even: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,1.0), IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE observer support; supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_NEAREST and GET confirms IEEE_NEAREST, asserts IEEE_RINT(2.5)==2.0, IEEE_RINT(3.5)==4.0, and IEEE_RINT(-2.5)==-2.0 with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE true for the negative result, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. These exact ties derive from p6 roundToIntegralExact using the current nearest mode. Mutations expect away-from-zero ties.
pending.IEEE_RINT-current-nearest-inexact-signal: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,2.5), IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support, IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INEXACT,2.5), and FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_INEXACT,2.5); supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_NEAREST and GET confirms IEEE_NEAREST, clears all supported flags, evaluates IEEE_RINT(2.5), and asserts IEEE_INEXACT signaling because p6 cites roundToIntegralExact and the rounded result differs from X, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. Mutation uses integral X=3.0.
pending.IEEE_RINT-current-nearest-inexact-quiet-: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(IEEE_NEAREST,3.0), IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support, IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INEXACT,3.0), and FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_INEXACT,3.0); supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_NEAREST and GET confirms IEEE_NEAREST, clears all supported flags, evaluates IEEE_RINT(3.0), and asserts IEEE_INEXACT remains quiet because p6 cites roundToIntegralExact and the result equals X, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. Mutation uses X=2.5.
